id: title:adamleithp:keep views in views and add a quill icon stack

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a UI hint and search filtering for the Products sidebar, potentially improving discoverability of dashboards, notebooks, and canvases.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F3.H1, P1.F7.H1, and P1.F2.H3 implements a complete, bounded feature: a new UI hint component, the search filtering logic, and the conditional rendering of the sidebar. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. The chunk P1.F14 and P1.F17 are excluded from scoring as they contain only documentation and Storybook implementation, not production-app
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the implementation of the IconStack and shared tooltip components, which are not present in this chunk; the tier is assigned based on the demonstrated implementation of the hint and search, while acknowledging the dependency on unreviewed shared primitives.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds a new function, viewTypesForPaneSearch, to the pane search module, and its unit tests, to filter view types based on search queries.

observations.posthog_connection: Changes the sidebar's conditional rendering and the order of sections, potentially affecting the user's workflow and the visibility of relevant tools and views.
